@jukkar I don't have access. Can you grant me an access or should I ask someone else?

> @awojasinski do you have access to coverity site? It would be great if these issues could be marked as resolved or false positive there so that coverity will not report these issues again.

coverity will not report those again if the fix is correct for a real issue, for false positive, yes, they need to be marked.
I cannot create account there, perhaps @nashif can guide you here.
If all the issues were real, so no false positives, then I think we are fine and nothing needs to be set in coverity site.

> If all the issues were real, so no false positives, then I think we are fine and nothing needs to be set in coverity site.

there is one false positive I've already closed #74803. @nashif if you could mark it as false positive in coverity I would be very grateful.

> there is one false positive I've already closed #74803. @nashif if you could mark it as false positive in coverity I would be very grateful.

No need to bother Anas with such a minor detail, I have an account in Coverity so I can fix that tomorrow. But as you are the maintainer there might be new coverity issues in the future so it would make sense to create an account there, it just does not scale if someone else needs to tweak coverity for those issues. I am not sure how the account is created, I did that so many years ago that I have forgotten such a minor detail. Anyway, Anas might be able to help you to create the account.
